title: Tester Acceptance as Expected Check Indicator
statement: For every $m\in\mathbb{N}$, Boolean input word $w$ of length $m+2$, and Boolean proof word $q$ of length $m+1$, the uniform string tester's acceptance is the expected value, over a uniformly chosen seed $s\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\sqcup\mathrm{Fin}(m)$, of the indicator that the partial-sum check specified by $s$ holds for $w$ and $q$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean word of length $m+2$
$q$ is a Boolean proof word of length $m+1$
